controls_note: A pass that denies every host it probes cannot distinguish 'these hosts are denied' from 'the probe is broken'. The reachable control answering 200 is what separates them.
method: Two HTTPS GETs per host through this environment's egress proxy, redirects not followed, descriptive user-agent, 20s timeout, verdict classified on the response body rather than the status code. Read-only; no credential, no account, nothing published, no spend.

why_this_file_exists: consolidate.py --ingest walks portfolio/research/ for machine-readable results files. A host measured in prose, or measured by a pass living outside that tree, is invisible to it -- and because --probe iterates the table --ingest builds, an invisible host is also never re-measured. These two were invisible on both counts. Each record names, in `source`, the document that first measured it; the verdict fields are this pass's own re-measurement, taken with probe_host() so the body-based classification rule this directory established applies. Extended 2026-08-24 with the hosting control planes measured by platform/deployment/probe_control_planes.py, for the same reason: a pass living outside portfolio/research/ is invisible to --ingest, so its hosts would sit in a second table nobody re-probes. One table, one command.
